result.title: Instance-Adaptive Online Multiclass Multicalibration
result.summary: We study online multiclass multicalibration over $T$ rounds, and give an algorithm with beyond-worst-case guarantees. With $n$ possible outcomes, forecasts lie in a simplex of dimension $d=n-1$. In the worst case, cumulative $\ell_1$ multicalibration error scales with $\widetildeΘ(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$, which becomes untenable once $d$ exceeds a small constant. Our algorithm adapts to the geometry of the realized sequence: if the sequence of adversarially selected outcome means lies in an affine subspace of dimension $s$, it obtains error $\widetilde O(n^{1/(s+2)}T^{(s+1)/(s+2)})$ with high probability. The algorithm adapts to this structure without knowing the subspace or its dimension. For $T\ge n\ge2$, this rate is minimax optimal up to polylogarithmic factors. For a stochastic instance with a fixed conditional mean, the bound specializes to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$, giving a square-root dependence on the horizon.

AI.brief_summary: 研究在线多类 multicalibration：当对抗选择的结果均值落在未知 s 维仿射子空间时，算法在不知道子空间及其维度的情况下取得优于最坏情况的校准误差率，并给出 minimax 最优性与随机情形下的平方根率。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「自适应未知内在结构、超越最坏情况」的实例自适应界，可能为推理期动态计算/长度分配与成本评价提供类比模板，可供核查。
